title: Anti-Nogo-A treatment enhances corticospinal tract sprouting and functional recovery after unilateral cervical lesion in adult primates
protocol: Habituate the monkey to the primate chair.
Train the monkey on various motor tasks daily to assess manual dexterity.
Establish pre-lesion behavioral scores over 2 months.
Perform a cervical hemi-section at C7.
Place an osmotic pump to deliver the antibody for 4 weeks.
Test the motor performance daily after the lesion to establish post-lesion behavioral scores.
Inject BDA at multiple sites in the contralesional motor cortex.
Prepare sections (50 microns thick) of the brain and spinal cord for histochemistry.
